summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of VehicleFilterModern component on /vehicle-auctions page. All 10 requested features tested and working correctly: glassmorphism design with backdrop-blur, status pills (All/Ending Soon/Live Now/No Reserve), 4 primary dropdowns, More Filters expand/collapse, Price Range slider, Year Range slider, Max Mileage/Transmission dropdowns, View toggle (Grid/List), Active filter badges, and Clear All functionality. Mobile responsiveness verified with 44px+ tap targets.
critical_code_review_comments: VehicleFilterModern.js properly implements glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-2xl and border-white/20
All interactive elements have min-h-[44px] or min-h-[48px] for touch accessibility compliance
Status pills have overflow-x-auto for horizontal scroll on mobile
GlassSelectTrigger and GlassSelectContent components provide consistent styling across dropdowns
Price and Year range sliders use React state properly with useCallback for performance optimization
Active filter badges include X button for easy removal and Clear All for bulk reset
seed_data_creation: None - Using live /api/vehicles endpoint with 0 active auctions (Discovery Mode)
context_for_next_testing_agent: VehicleFilterModern component fully tested. Key features verified: glassmorphism design, status pills, 4 primary dropdowns (Make/Body Type/Location/Sort By), More Filters panel with Price/Year range sliders and Max Mileage/Transmission dropdowns, View toggle, Active filter badges, Clear All, and mobile responsiveness with 44px+ tap targets. All tests pass.

features_tested: VehicleFilterModern component renders correctly on /vehicle-auctions page
Status pills (All, Ending Soon, Live Now, No Reserve) clickable and toggle active state
Make dropdown - opens, shows categorized options (Popular/Luxury/Other), selectable
Body Type dropdown - shows all 8 body types, selectable
Location dropdown - shows Canadian provinces, selectable
Sort By dropdown - shows 5 sort options (Ending Soon/Newest Listed/Price/Year/Mileage)
More Filters button expands/collapses extended filters panel with animation
Price Range slider with dual handles and min/max input fields
Year Range slider with dual handles (1990 to current year+1)
Max Mileage dropdown with mileage threshold options
View toggle (Grid/List) switches active state correctly
Active filter badges appear when filters are applied with X to remove
Clear All button removes all active filters and resets to defaults
Mobile responsiveness - 44px+ minimum tap targets verified
Horizontal scroll for status pills on mobile
